description: Compare two domains to find shared keyword deficits, advantages, and target1-exclusive keyword opportunities. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

intersections.description: True requests shared keywords; false requests keywords exclusive to target1. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of intersecting or target1-exclusive keyword records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 5. Maximum: 250. Default: 25.

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

location_code.description: Numeric provider location identifier for the search market; the service validates support alongside the location name. Type: Safe integer. Must be greater than 0. Optional; no client default.

min_search_volume.description: Minimum estimated monthly keyword searches to include; zero disables this lower-bound filter. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000000. Default: 0.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "opportunity", "search_volume", "traffic_gap", "rank_gap", "cpc". Default: "opportunity".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target1.description: Your comparison target as a domain, subdomain or page URL; results are interpreted relative to this first target. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

target2.description: Second domain, subdomain or page URL used as the comparison target. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_domain_intersection
title: AgentSEO Domain Intersection
